_comment: Harmful self-enchantment families for VTank 'Use Dispel Items' / 'Cast dispel self' (G:26-27, PLAN Q12): a row of TryGetSelfEnchantments() with !isBeneficial, a `family` (= SpellCategory) in `categories` and spell level >= `minLevel` triggers a dispel. Derived from the Appendix C debuff families; categories read from LSD spells.json (meta_spell.spell.spellCategory) for the seed ids listed in `byCategory`. Life-school rows (`lifeCategories`) are the only ones Eradicate Life Magic Self (3194) can remove, so the cast path is limited to them, and to rows whose powerLevel <= `castDispelMaxPower` (3194 "Dispels 3-6 negative Life Magic enchantments of level 7 or lower", LSD meta_spell max_power 350; a level-8 Incantation has power 400); a dispel item is tried for every listed category. Reviewable: add categories here, no code change needed.

byCategory.38: Vulnerability Other = melee-defense debuff (Creature; gravity family: 15, 230, 2318 Gravity Well, 4633)
byCategory.40: Defenselessness Other = missile-defense debuff (Creature; broadside family: 262, 2228 Broadside of a Barn, 4543)
byCategory.42: Magic Yield Other = magic-defense debuff (Creature; yield family: 280, 2282 Futility, 4597)
